 Early voting begins for Saluda mayor and Sumter school board runoffs 
 Early voting begins for Saluda mayor and Sumter school board runoffs By WIS News 10 Staff Published : Nov. 12, 2026 at 7:32 AM EST | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google COLUMBIA, S.C. (WIS) - Early voting begins today for runoff elections in the town of Saluda and Sumter County School Board District 8.
 In Saluda, mayoral candidates Miliken Matthews and Josh Morton are headed to a runoff after finishing one vote apart, according to SC Votes. Matthews received 354 votes, and Morton received 353. With three write-in votes, neither candidate received a majority.
 In Sumter County, Phil Leventis and Sherril Ray were the top two finishers in the School Board District 8 race, but neither received a majority.
 Early voting for both races is available today and Friday from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 17, with polls open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 Voters can check their assigned polling place at SC Votes and should bring a photo ID. For more information, contact the county elections office or visit SC Votes.
